projects.title: Sri Lankan Tea Auction Price Analysis and Predictive Research Workflow
projects.description: A research-based data science project that analyzes Sri Lankan tea auction price behavior using real-world auction, production, weather, and market segment data. The project focuses on preprocessing, feature engineering, exploratory analysis, and preparation for predictive modeling.
